name: CPEI Women's & Men's Curling Championships
description:
Jan. 13-17, 2027 @ Cornwall Curling Club

Competitors may be any age.  

All curlers entered in this event must be members in good standing with a Curl PEI member club and Curl PEI.

Only coaches who are Club Coach Trained; Intro Comp Coach Trained; or old Level 1 Certified, have completed NCCP's Safe Sport Module, submitted a criminal record check to Curl PEI and is listed on a team’s registration form may access the ice surface during the event. Please ensure coaches have completed their membership [here] (https://pe.curling.io/en/products/11071-2026-27-coach-membership).

Communications will be sent to one team contact, as listed in the registration form, the team contact is responsible for sharing the information with the entire team.

Winners have the right, but are not required, to advance to their respective national championship - the Scotties Tournament of Hearts, operated by Curling Canada or the Montana's Brier, operated by Curling Canada.

Please review [Curling Canada's Team Travel & Funding Policies](https://www.curling.ca/about-us/policies/) as there are some changes in effect for the 2026/27 season.
